item.title: Cabinet approves Rs. 12,000 crore for rural drinking water under Jal Jeevan Mission
item.description: The Union Cabinet approved an outlay of Rs. 12,000 crore to extend functional household tap connections, with priority for Telangana, Andhra Pradesh and Maharashtra.

item.title: MSP for Kharif crops increased; paddy MSP raised
item.description: Minimum Support Prices for Kharif crops for the marketing season have been increased to ensure remunerative prices to farmers.

item.title: Staff Selection Commission announces 8,500 vacancies in Multi Tasking Staff examination
item.description: Online applications are invited. Last date: 15-10-2026.
